verdict.rationale: Jules publishes a usage-limits page defining plan tiers with daily task/concurrency numbers (e.g. '300...60' for power users) and community reports confirm real-world limit changes (daily task limit dropping from 60 to 15) and credit exhaustion issues, showing limits exist and are enforced. However there's no evidence of an engineering-lead-facing admin console for viewing/managing team-wide usage, adjusting concurrency, or per-seat quota controls — it's a static pricing page, not a management interface. Missing for 10: team/org usage dashboard, per-user or per-team concurrency controls, ability to adjust or request limit changes, and independent confirmation of any admin-level management UI.
